questions.question: A thief is spotted by a policeman from a distance of 400 m. When the policeman starts chasing, the thief also starts running. If the speed of the thief is 32 km/h and that of the policeman is 40 km/h, then how far would the thief have run before he is overtaken?
questions.solution:
Given:

Distance between policeman and thief = 400 m

Speed of policeman = 40 km/h

Speed of thief = 32 km/h

Formula used:

Distance = relative speed × time

Calculation:

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ 400 = (40 - 32) × (5/18) × time

⇒ 400 = 8 × (5/18) × time

⇒ Time = (400 × 18)/40 = 180 sec

Distance travelled by thief = 32 × (5/18) × 180

⇒ 32 × 5 × 10 = 1600 m 

**∴ The correct answer is 1600 m.**

questions.question: The cube of the difference between two given natural numbers is 1728, while the product of these two given numbers is 108. Find the positive difference between the cubes of these two given numbers.
questions.solution:

1st natural number × 2nd natural number = 108

**Formula used:**

(A - B)³ = A³ - B³ - 3AB × (A - B)

**Calculation:**

Let 1st natural number = A

2nd natural number = B

(A - B)³ = 1728

⇒ (A - B) = ³√1728 = 12

A³ - B³ = (A - B)³ + 3AB × (A - B)

⇒ 1728 + 3 × 108 × 12

⇒ 1728 + 3 × 108 × 12

⇒ 1728 + 3888 = 5616

**∴ The correct answer is 5616.**

questions.question: A conical tent of height 10 m and base diameter 48 m was erected by a company in a park. Find the curved surface area of the tent (In m²).
questions.solution:

Height of tent (H) = 10 m

Base diameter (D) = 48 m

The curved surface area of the cone = π × R × l

Where, l = √(H² + R²) 

R = radius ; l = slant height

**Calculation:**

Base diameter (D) = 48 m

Base radius (R) = 48/2 = 24 m

Slant height (l) = √(H2 + R2)

⇒ √{(10)2 + (24)2}

⇒ √{100 + 576} = √676

⇒ 26 m

The curved surface area of the cone = π × R × l

⇒ π × 24 × 26 = 624 π m² 

**∴ The correct answer is 624 π m2. **

questions.question: The third proportional to (x² - y²) and (x - y) is:

questions.question: Two trains P and Q of lengths 320 m and 540 m, respectively, are running in the same direction on parallel tracks at 108 km/h and 144 km/h, respectively. How much time will the trains take to cross each other completely?
questions.solution:

Length of 1st train (T₁) = 320 m

Length of 1st train (T₂) = 540 m

Speed of 1st train (S₁) = 108 km/h

Speed of 1st train (S₂) = 144 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ (T1 + T2) = (S2 - S1) × (5/18) × time

⇒ (320 + 540) = (144 - 108) × (5/18) × time

⇒ 860 = 36 × (5/18) × time

⇒ Time = 860/10 = 86 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 86 sec.**

questions.question: If the simple Interest for 5 years is equal to 25% of the principal, then the Interest will be equal to the principal after ______ years.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest (S.I) = 25% × Principal

Time = 5 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time

**Calculation:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 25/100 × P = (P × R × 5)/100

⇒ 25 = R × 5

⇒ R = 5%

According to the question:

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ P = (P × 5 × T)/100

⇒ T = 100/5 = 20 years

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

questions.question: Raj’s income is Rs. 45,000 and his expenditure is Rs. 33,000. If his income is increased by 20% and expenditure by 12%, then what will be the percentage increase in saving?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Income : Expenditure : Savings = 45000 : 33000 : 12000 = 15 : 11 : 4

Using the weighted average method: Income = Expenditure + Savings

Let the percentage increase in savings be x%.

15 × 20% = 11 × 12% + 4 × x ⇒ 300% = 132% + 4x ⇒ 4x = 168% ⇒ x = 42%

**∴ The correct answer is 42%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Income = ₹45,000

Initial Expenditure = ₹33,000

Income is increased by 20% and Expenditure is increased by 12%.

**Formula Used:**

Savings = Income − Expenditure

Percentage Increase = (Increase in Value ÷ Original Value) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a65412a82785a82ec15c9150c672853ca11c5292282400ba4b7b06e94055e4e2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial Savings = ₹45,000 − ₹33,000 = ₹12,000

⇒ New Income = ₹45,000 + (20% of ₹45,000) = ₹45,000 + ₹9,000 = ₹54,000

⇒ New Expenditure = ₹33,000 + (12% of ₹33,000) = ₹33,000 + ₹3,960 = ₹36,960

⇒ New Savings = New Income − New Expenditure

⇒ New Savings = ₹54,000 − ₹36,960 = ₹17,040

⇒ Increase in Savings = ₹17,040 − ₹12,000 = ₹5,040

⇒ Percentage increase in savings = (5,040 ÷ 12,000) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase in savings = 42%

**∴ The correct answer is 42%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income and Expenditure Concept

Income is always the sum of Expenditure and Savings. Any absolute or percentage change in income naturally distributes across changes in both expenditure and savings.

Weighted Average (Alligation) Method

When a base quantity is divided into two parts, the net percentage change in the total is mathematically equivalent to the weighted average of the percentage changes in its individual parts: I × I% = E × E% + S × S%.

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage Change = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100. A positive result directly indicates an increase, while a negative result indicates a decrease.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers Is divisible by 24?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 8:

If the last three digits of a number are divisible by 8, the number is divisible by 8.

Divisibility rule of 3:

a number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.

24 = 3 × 8

If a number is divisible by 3 and 8 then it is also divisible by 24.

**Calculation:**

We need to check it by option:

Option 1:

Number = 52688

Sum of digits = 5 + 2 + 6 + 8 + 8 = 29

29 is not divisible by 3. so the number is not divisible by 3.

So the number is also not divisible by 24.

Option 2:

Number = 49512

Sum of digits = 4 + 9 + 5 + 1 + 2 = 21

21 is divisible by 3. so the number is divisible by 3.

The last three digits of the number = 512

512 is divisible by 8, so the number is also divisible by 8.

So the number is divisible by 24.

**∴ The correct option is 2.**

A, B, and C be the mid-points of sides PQ, QR and PR.

Concept used:

The line segment in a triangle joining the midpoint of any two sides of the triangle,

is said to be parallel to its third side and is also half of the length of the third side.

Heron's formula:

Area = √{S(S - a)(S - b)(S - c)}

Where, S = (a + b + c)/2

And a, b, and c are the sides of the triangle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25197ccdd90dde6bda1440ca011c1392779980c08df4fe22e7d53eaa46f59737.png] 

Semi-perimeter (S) = (PQ + QR + PR)/2

Area of △XYZ = √S(S - p)(S - q)(S - r)

⇒ √[(PQ + QR + PR)/2 × {(PQ + QR + PR)/2 - QR} × {(PQ + QR + PR)/2 - PR} × {(PQ + QR + PR)/2 - PQ}]

⇒ √[(PQ + QR + PR)/2 × {(PQ + QR + PR) - 2QR}/2 × {(PQ + QR + PR) - 2PR}/2 × {(PQ + QR + PR) - 2PQ}/2]

⇒ √[(PQ + QR + PR)/2 × (PQ + QR + PR)/2 × (PQ + QR + PR)/2 × (PQ + QR + PR)/2]

⇒ (PQ + QR + PR)2/4 = 32 cm2 -------- (1)

With the midpoint theorem:

AC = QR/2 ; AB = PR/2 ; BC = PQ/2

Semi-perimeter (S) = (AB + BC + AC)/2

⇒ {(PR/2) + (PQ/2) + (QR/2)}/2

⇒ (PR + PQ + QR)/4

Area of △ABC = √S(S - p)(S - q)(S - r)

⇒ √[(PR + PQ + QR)/4 × {(PR + PQ + QR)/4 - QR/2} × {(PR + PQ + QR)/4 - PR/2} × {(PR + PQ + QR)/4 - PQ/2}]

⇒ √[(PR + PQ + QR)/4 × {(PR + PQ + QR) - 2QR}/4 × {(PR + PQ + QR) - 2PR}/4 × {(PR + PQ + QR) - 2PQ}/4]

⇒ √[(PR + PQ + QR)/4 × (PR + PQ + QR)/4 × (PR + PQ + QR)/4 × (PR + PQ + QR)/4]

⇒ (PR + PQ + QR)2/(4 ×4)

⇒ 32/4 = 8 cm2 ------ From (1)

∴ The correct answer is 8 cm2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Concept used:

Area of △ABC = (1/4) × Area of △PQR

Calculation:

Area of △ABC = (1/4) × Area of △PQR

⇒ 32/4 = 8 cm2

∴ The correct answer is 8 cm2.

The tangent to the circle is perpendicular to the radius of the circle at the point of contact.

Pythagorean theorem:

H² = P² + B²

Where, H = hypotenuse ; P = perpendicular ; B = base

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a051969712e0057da5ecbdc463ea2a58456bc127bdabb7294c1685d5e23f427.png]

questions.question: If tan (A)/(2)=x, then find x.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

tan (A/2) = x

**Formula used:**

tan (A/2) = ± frac{sqrt{1-cos A}}{sqrt{1+cos A}}

**Calculation:**

tan (A/2) = x

⇒ frac{sqrt{1-cos A}}{sqrt{1+cos A}} = x

⇒ x = frac{sqrt{1-cos A}}{sqrt{1+cos A}}

**∴ The correct option is 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

We know: tan(A/2) = sin(A/2) / cos(A/2).

 

Sin(A/2) can be derived by the Pythagorean Identity, sin²λ + cos²λ = 1, which means sinλ = √(1 - cos²λ). So, sin(A/2) = √(1 - cos²(A/2)).

 

Putting this into the equation, we get

 

tan(A/2) = √(1 - cos²(A/2)) / cos(A/2) .......(i)

 

Now, from half angle formula, 

 

cos(A/2) = √((1 + cosA) / 2) .......(ii)

 

value of (ii) put in equation (i):-

 

tan(A/2) = √[1 - √{(1 + cosA)²/ 4}] / √((1 + cosA) / 2)

 

tan(A/2) = √[1 - {(1 + cosA)/ 2}] / √((1 + cosA) / 2)

tan(A/2) = √((2 - 1 - cosA)/ 2) / √((1 + cosA) / 2)

tan(A/2) = √((1 - cosA)/ 2) / √((1 + cosA) / 2)

tan(A/2) = ±√(1 - cosA) / √(1 + cosA).

 

**So, option 3 is the correct answer.**
